title: Innovation assessment
scope: LabourLens researches public Singapore labour statistics and reports for Q1 2024 to Q2 2026. Analysts inspect citations, records and tool calls before using an answer.
abstract: Period filters and reranking select passages; typed read-only tools retrieve series and calculate changes. I measured retrieval, answer behaviour, runtime and attack responses. The next priorities are report-table arithmetic and independent evaluation.
approach: Numbers come from validated tables or deterministic code; claims cite passages or records.
Period and release filters precede reranking; preliminary and final releases stay labelled.
A bounded agent uses typed read-only tools, including an MCP statistics server.
Evaluation uses fixed reference sets, retained negative results and an attack suite.

sections.title: Retrieval and answer quality
sections.summary: Validate report tables before adding retrieval complexity.

paragraphs.text: Retrieval used 128 development text questions. Answer evaluation used 237 development, 31 original-test and 65 fresh-test questions, with two runs per arm. Behaviour accuracy measures answer, abstain, clarify or refuse status, not factual correctness.
Historical fresh-set numerical accuracy was 0.214 (3/14). The attempted tool extension failed its criteria and was rejected.

proposals.title: Report-table extraction
proposals.gap: Tools cannot calculate reliably over report figures.
proposals.measure: Verify cells, units, population and row/column lineage; test paired numerical and false-answer rates.
proposals.threshold: Numerical regression accuracy at least 0.50; no rise in all-question false-answer rate; unchanged definition/citation checks.

proposals.title: Period restatements and coverage
proposals.gap: Period filters miss later restatements; quarters, series and languages are incomplete.
proposals.measure: Test restatements; add reviewed MOM/MTI/SingStat series and language cases. Exclude table_unreliable cells from calculation.
proposals.threshold: No regression on definition, revision-conflict or citation cases before extending coverage.

sections.title: Drift detection
sections.summary: Gate releases and monitor fixed probes.

paragraphs.text: Snapshots, corpus fingerprints and gold hashes record inputs.

proposals.title: Release gates and probes
proposals.gap: Corpus, prompt, embedding and provider changes can alter answers.
proposals.measure: Check schemas, periods and revisions; rerun evaluation after every corpus/prompt/model change. Pin versions, alert on provider changes and probe embedding drift. Track hit rate, abstention, citation validity, grounded numbers, latency and cost.
proposals.threshold: Hold unexplained regressions; retain rollback versions. Detect seeded regressions within one daily probe cycle.

proposals.title: Question-family review
proposals.gap: Researchers' requests can diverge from evaluation coverage.
proposals.measure: Sample minimised, pseudonymised logs and feedback by family, including clarification rates.
proposals.threshold: Review material shifts before changing coverage; derive alerts from an approved operating baseline.

sections.title: Provenance, explainability and review
sections.summary: Base confidence on evidence coverage and reviewer agreement.

paragraphs.text: Citations, observation lineage, abstention reasons, conflict flags, an evidence drawer and tool traces support inspection. Thumbs/comments link to the run's question, calls, answer and citations; no improvement loop consumes them.

proposals.title: Evidence inspection and review
proposals.measure: Add table-row locators, side-by-side sources and coverage/review indicators. Analysts label before AI suggestions, then adjudicate. Extend second-family judging and repeated runs. Preserve provenance in saved analyses, cited exports and revision alerts.
proposals.threshold: At least three reviewers; kappa at least 0.70; 95% accuracy interval width at most 0.10.

proposals.title: Feedback review loop
proposals.gap: Stored votes do not currently produce reviewed tests.
proposals.measure: Review every thumbs-down and sample thumbs-up. Label evidence, number, period/population, abstention or style failures. Before fixing each confirmed failure, write a question with expected evidence for the next fresh set. Select one lever: filter/rerank, table extraction, planner prompt, validator or corpus gap. Change one thing; tune on development, report on fresh questions. Track weekly votes and abstention by family after corpus/prompt/model changes. Pseudonymise comments; limit retention.
proposals.threshold: Each confirmed failure has a pre-fix case and lever. No fine-tuning on votes, unreviewed votes as truth or thumbs-up prompt examples: these leak tests and reward fluent errors.

sections.title: Security, privacy and third-party risk
sections.summary: Require approved access, hosting, retention and model terms.

paragraphs.text: Tools are bounded and read-only; retrieved text is isolated and MCP responses validated. Scanner detections rose 10/30 to 23/30; benign flags stayed 9/30. Fresh attacks scored 35/36 across configurations.

proposals.title: Access and processing controls
proposals.gap: Demo access and external model processing lack government approval.
proposals.measure: Clear licences, rights and publisher agreements. Add SSO/source roles; approve residency, private endpoints, retention and audit access. Review provider terms; retain exportable evidence and a tested vendor exit plan.
proposals.threshold: No sensitive deployment before approval. Provider failure returns unavailable or approved cached analysis, never an unvalidated fallback.

proposals.title: Injection and MCP testing
proposals.gap: Pattern scanning lacks independent generalisation evidence.
proposals.measure: Retain least privilege and content isolation. Test a stronger classifier on independent paraphrases; maintain server allow-lists, incident owners and recurring red-team reviews.
proposals.threshold: Pass threat regressions without relaxing permissions; report misses and false positives.

sections.title: Latency and cost
sections.summary: Accept cheaper routing only after quality checks.

paragraphs.text: All-tools MCP scored 0.877 (57/65) versus statistics-only 0.908 (59/65); median latency 14.3/12.4 s, p95 51.4/34.7 s. It was rejected.

proposals.title: Caches, routing and budgets
proposals.gap: Repeated context and optional calls consume latency and spend.
proposals.measure: Retain embedding caches; test revision-keyed retrieval/answer caches, filter-only routing and smaller triage/rerank models. Invalidate on revisions. Add token/call/cost budgets, p95 alerts and provider caps.
proposals.threshold: p95 below 40 s; mean cost below $0.005/question on an approved mix; no regression in citation support, numerical correctness or abstention.

sections.title: Priorities and measurement
sections.summary: Prioritise numerical evidence and independent evaluation.

proposals.title: First: report-table arithmetic
proposals.gap: Historical numerical accuracy was 0.214; the previous tool change failed.
proposals.measure: Pre-register one extraction/tool change. Use 14 known cases for regression, then confirm on new blind numerical questions; compare paired false-answer rates and definition/citation checks.
proposals.threshold: Regression accuracy at least 0.50; no rise in all-question false-answer rate; unchanged definition/citation checks. Reject a failed gate.

proposals.title: Second: independent review
proposals.gap: The label process cannot establish independent accuracy.
proposals.measure: Three analysts independently label a stratified blind set before AI suggestions, then adjudicate. Pre-register sampling; expand if needed; never tune on it. Report semantic support, numerical correctness and run variance separately.
proposals.threshold: Fleiss' kappa at least 0.70 on behaviour labels; headline 95% case-bootstrap accuracy interval width at most 0.10.

limitations: Development shaped the design. Original-test evidence overlaps; fresh-test outcomes are known. Neither final test demonstrates a gain.
Gold was AI-drafted and reviewed by one person; the main judge is same-family. Two runs do not estimate variance.
Citations check mechanics; arithmetic can use wrong inputs. Scanner and attack results establish no general defence.
Full comparisons exclude web-only steps and MCP. Costs are list-price estimates. Monitoring, rollback and government readiness are untested.

components.replacement: Approved private endpoints and processing terms.

components.current: Report rights, some licences and employment population basis unverified.
components.replacement: Publisher agreements, rights review and validated definitions.

components.current: No live capability mocked; hostile-server fixtures are synthetic tests.
